_readme: Measured values only. Every entry is reproducible by the command in `how`. Never hand-edit a number that was not actually observed.

success_metric.name: validated_out_of_sample_performance_and_reliability
success_metric.resolution: TENSIONS T-1 resolved as option C. Out-of-sample performance is measured by walk-forward backtesting of indicator rules, not by a price forecaster.
success_metric.important_caveat: The backtest RETURN figures are facts about the market and the ticker, not about this system. Treating them as a number to improve would mean tuning rules until they look good, which is the data mining the engine exists to expose. What is tracked as OUR metric is the VALIDITY of the measurement and the reliability of the system -- not how well any rule happens to score.

validity_criteria.no_lookahead: positions shifted one bar after signal; guard test uses a perfect-foresight oracle
validity_criteria.costs_charged: 10 bps default on every position change
validity_criteria.held_out_slice: parameter chosen on train only; leakage test tampers with test data and asserts the choice is unchanged
validity_criteria.all_results_reported: every rule returned with parameters_tried, never just the winner
